body:
Scope: milestone M1, complete current engineering diff including policy and approved upstream artifacts, specialist consumers, selective packaged guidance, governing references, candidate metadata and bounded selector/lifecycle validator changes. M2 retains a distinct fresh final whole-change review and successful Verify.

The diff satisfies the approved clause-level ownership extraction. Shared adopted assessment and reliance applications define independence, combined-condition judgment, applicability, correction/disposition, proof reuse and closeout. Explicitly historical instructions retain historical meaning. Specialist methods remain usable, installed skills carry local selective resources, and the plan identifies mandatory final independent review after implementation/corrections and before Verify. No schema, CLI readiness decision, new stage, migration or external-action authority is introduced.

All ten review checklist dimensions were assessed: requirement alignment, test coverage, edge cases, error handling, architecture, compatibility, security/privacy, generated currency, unrelated changes and evidence. Named consumer dispositions and TG-1 scenarios were independently compared with the source, including blocked/inconclusive overlap with bounded findings, optional notes, role-reset independence, bookkeeping plus new failed proof, final engineering changes, Verify-owned blockers, concurrency/recovery, proof environment changes, single/doc-only final review and advisory isolation. These are manual guidance assessments, not runtime policy-judge traces or measured token savings.

Validator regressions demonstrate missing/drifted resources and unknown consumers fail closed. JSON owners use existing complete-set validation for malformed/unknown records and selected tracked snapshots do not borrow valid live replacements; historical YAML behavior is retained. Generated candidate hashes use existing tooling and keep local-release-candidate provenance and historical metadata. The unrelated docs/design.zip remains excluded and untouched.

Inspected actual command evidence: python scripts/validate-skills.py (20 skills), python scripts/test-skill-validator.py (370), python scripts/test-build-skills.py (8), python scripts/build-skills.py --check, three-adapter build/parity for v0.1.5 and current v0.5.1, adapter-distribution suite plus passing current-metadata correction rerun, lifecycle suite (171) plus current v2 regressions, selector regression/integrated selector suite, npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop (654 total, 652 passed, 2 skipped), isolated lifecycle shared-path rerun, model/metadata/lifecycle validations. I independently ran git diff HEAD --check and read the final npm and lifecycle rerun logs. Current m1-focused-validation preserves intermediate failures and applicability rationale: the integrated wrapper was not wholly passing; its fixture collision and old candidate pin were corrected and rerun. Sequential PR-mode integrated validation remains an M2 obligation. No hosted-CI or final Verify success is claimed.

Exact engineering subjects below and mechanically inspected current upstream approvals/evidence support this milestone assessment. Earlier resolved Design finding origins are historical identities and do not negate current package approval. Recording this review changes no engineering subject; relevant new evidence or engineering edits still require applicability reassessment.
independence_basis: Separate delegated agent /root/independent_proposal_review performed this assessment. Root authored implementation and coordinated proof. This reviewer authored no engineering subjects, tests or packaged resources; earlier independent upstream reviews are assessment work, not engineering authorship. Independence is an actual separate execution, not an author role reset.
